chapter: Chapter VII — Cities and the Sky 2
calvino_inner_arch: Torn between honoring an imagined heaven of solid gold and diamond locks and fearing an underground sewer twin of overturned rubbish bins, terrestrial Beersheba grows grim, calculating, and authoritarian—turning its own carat hoard into the true clockwork inferno while remaining blind to the weightless zenith planet built of humble discarded potato peels, broken umbrellas, old socks, candy wrappings, tram tickets, and eggshell cupolas, touched only in rare uncalculated generous release.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Vertical Triad Cosmology Observatory & Avarice-Release Escapement Valve

canonical_stones.label: Imagined Solid-Gold & Diamond Heaven
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Citizens mistakenly imagine a celestial body of solid gold with silver locks, diamond gates, and supreme filigree inlays.

canonical_stones.label: Overturned Rubbish Bins & Sewer Twin
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Citizens fear a subterranean twin roofed with overturned rubbish bins spilling cheese rinds, fish scales, spaghetti, bandages, and dark sewer pitch.

canonical_stones.label: Terrestrial Carat-Vault Clockwork Inferno
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Obsessed with hoarding carats and policing waste, earthly Beersheba tightens into dark iron authoritarian clockwork gears—becoming the true inferno.

canonical_stones.label: Eggshell Cupolas of the Zenith
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Translucent, fragile eggshell domes crowning the true weightless Beersheba at the zenith.

canonical_stones.label: Orbiting Potato Peels
canonical_stones.calvino_role: A free celestial planet a-flutter with spiraling humble potato peels.

canonical_stones.label: Broken Umbrellas & Old Socks
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Weightless broken-ribbed umbrellas and worn old socks drifting lucidly through upper space.

canonical_stones.label: Candy Wrappings, Glass Bits & Popped Buttons
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Glistening candy wrappings, bits of broken glass, and loose buttons catching celestial starlight.

canonical_stones.label: Tram-Ticket & Callus Pavements
canonical_stones.calvino_role: Celestial piazzas paved with punched tram tickets, fingernail-cuttings, and pared calluses.

causal_invariants.avariceTightensClockworkInferno: Hoarding carats increases avariceIndex and authoritarianCompression, locking all 8 vault bolts, ratcheting dark iron gears, and disconnecting earth from the zenith (earthTouchesZenith === false).
causal_invariants.generousUncalculatedReleaseIlluminatesZe: Triggering generous uncalculated release drops avariceIndex, unlatches escapements (isCalculating === false), sends humble detritus ascending, and illuminates the eggshell-domed zenith (earthTouchesZenith === true, celestialLuminance >= 0.85).
